input.title: Men's Fishing – Fishing Is My Love Language Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This fishing zip up hoodie is for the angler whose love language is fishing and whose idea of a conversation is a quiet dock, zipped on for the boat ramp and the cold bank.

A largemouth bass in sunglasses lounges in a striped beach chair beside a spinning rod, in olive, cream and charcoal with a worn print texture. FISHING IS MY LOVE LANGUAGE. runs above it and TALKING ISN'T. below in tall condensed capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: cream and gold on Black and Navy, forest green and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small fish with a fishing line and hook above its mouth is embroidered on the left chest, and the word QUIET is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest fish and hook and left-cuff QUIET, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Fishing Is My Love Language zip hoodie fit?
The Fishing Is My Love Language fishing zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this fishing hoodie warm enough for cold boat ramps?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold boat ramps, dawn docks and long drives home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, FISHING IS MY LOVE LANGUAGE. above the bass and TALKING ISN'T. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small fish with a fishing line and hook above its mouth sits on the left chest with no words, and QUIET is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The fish and hook on the chest and the QUIET cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for an angler, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the fisherman who says more with a quiet bank than with a conversation. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
